properties.name: MEASURED 2026-10-06: from v0.78.0 to v0.80.0 a plain get_instructions returned a table of contents and no instructions, because the served document passed the shared 30,000 default; the test the 2026-09-28 record says pins this was never committed
properties.statement:
MEASURED 2026-10-06 on a 0.80.0-line build (75ce623df): `get_instructions {}` returned instructions: null, returned_bytes 0, total_bytes 30285, budget.detail whole_document_withheld. get_instructions compares the document's BYTES (String::len) against budget_chars, which defaulted to the shared DEFAULT_REPLY_BUDGET_CHARS of 30,000, and withholds an over-budget document whole by design. getting-started/AGENTS.md went from 29,957 to 30,285 bytes on 2026-09-30 (45613b483). It is 30,285 bytes at v0.78.0, v0.79.0 and v0.80.0, so every plain call since, the one the handshake tells every session to make FIRST, got only the section manifest. That includes flo2.io (0.79.0) and every consumer on 0.80.0. Nothing failed.

WHY NOTHING CAUGHT IT: fact:the-served-instructions-sit-at-the-edge-of-the-default-reply-budget-and-nothing-pinned-it-2026-09-28 records its REPAIR as "crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/one_search_reaches_every_design_a_hub_tracks.rs asserts that get_instructions with no section and the default budget returns the whole document". No commit on any branch ever held that file (git log --all on the path: only design-record commits that quote the fact). The only tests calling get_instructions pass budget_chars 10,000,000 or a section. The record's headroom was also counted in characters (29,558, so 442 left), while the check compares bytes. TWO CLASSES: a recorded repair naming a test that does not exist, with nothing checking that a fact's named test exists; and a limit stated in a different unit from the check that applies it.

REPAIR (Anthony's ruling 2026-10-06, "No limit by default" over moving the tool inventory out or trimming to fit): get_instructions has no default limit. A plain call returns the whole document however long it grows, and a caller that names its cap (budget_chars) still gets the manifest and never half a document. Pinned by crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/a_plain_get_instructions_returns_the_whole_document_and_the_root_cause_rule_rides_it.rs. Positive control: run against the old default, its plain-call test fails with whole_document_withheld at 31,232 bytes. The cost accepted: a client whose cap is below the document (a ~22 KB one, fact:defect-the-served-instructions-put-their-standing-rules-where-a-client-cap-deletes-them) loses the tail rather than receiving a manifest. The standing rules come first and returned_bytes shows the cut.
